subject.title: [Bug]: scripts/pr GraphQL sync can lose rebased ancestry

question: Should script owners land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98765 as the fix for this issue, narrow it to refusal-only behavior, or reject the fail-closed ancestry-repair direction?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the repair changes protected maintainer PR publication semantics and is already represented by an open maintainer-labeled PR, so automation should not choose the workflow policy by itself.

options.title: Rebase and review the repair PR
options.body: Bring the open repair PR current, review the stricter GraphQL/git publication behavior, and close this issue after it lands.

options.title: Narrow to refusal-only
options.body: Land only the unsafe GraphQL topology refusal and track any explicit repair mode separately if the extra surface is too broad.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Keep the old GraphQL fallback behavior and close the issue plus repair PR with a maintainer policy explanation.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review the repair PR
recommendation.body: Bring the open repair PR current, review the stricter GraphQL/git publication behavior, and close this issue after it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this report, are assigned on the open repair PR, and have recent history in the affected prep-push path.
